ValidationRule.description: Ensures that when a Quote Request is saved with the stage set as "Request Closed", Site Selection, Quote Amount, respective Products, and Margin fields are populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL( Stage__c , "Request Closed"), RecordType.Name = 'Non-Calendar', OR( ISBLANK(Quote_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Valid_Through__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Site_Selection__c)),
IF(ISBLANK( Product_1__c), 0, 1) <> IF(ISBLANK( Product_1_Margin__c), 0, 1), IF(ISBLANK( Product_2__c), 0, 1) <> IF(ISBLANK( Product_2_Margin__c ), 0, 1), IF(ISBLANK( Product_3__c), 0, 1) <> IF(ISBLANK( Product_3_Margin__c ), 0, 1), IF(ISBLANK( Product_4__c ), 0, 1) <> IF(ISBLANK( Product_4_Margin__c ), 0, 1), IF(ISBLANK( Product_5__c ), 0, 1) <> IF(ISBLANK( Product_5_Margin__c ), 0, 1) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Quote Amount, Site Selection, Products, and Product Margin fields must be populated in order to close this quote. For example, for every Product field you've selected, there must be respective Product Margin field populated for that entry. Thank You
